title: DimensionValue
description: One {dimension_uri, code} pair carried by a MetricObservation. Ordering matters for SDMX DSD round-trip, so this is modelled as an ordered list of structured pairs rather than as a map.

dimension_uri.description: The URI of the MetricDimension whose code this DimensionValue carries.

code.description: The code from the dimension's code list that locates the observation along this dimension.
